name: eas-tools
description: Development, testing, and documentation tooling for EAS Tools

scripts.test:e2e: make e2e-check && cargo test --manifest-path test/e2e-rs/Cargo.toml --test e2e
scripts.test:e2e:container: make e2e-check && cargo test --manifest-path test/e2e-rs/Cargo.toml --test e2e -- --runner container
scripts.test:e2e:container-headless-shell: make e2e-check && cargo test --manifest-path test/e2e-rs/Cargo.toml --test e2e -- --runner container
scripts.test:e2e:container-full-chromium: make e2e-check && EAS_TOOLS_E2E_IMAGE=eas-tools-e2e:full-chromium EAS_TOOLS_E2E_BUILD_ARGS='--build-arg CHROMIUM_PACKAGE=chromium --build-arg CHROMIUM_BINARY=/usr/lib/chromium/chromium' cargo test --manifest-path test/e2e-rs/Cargo.toml --test e2e -- --runner container
